quotes.text: So guardrails is definitely important, but it shouldn't definitely, you know, I always say governance should not be the cost. It should be the enabler
quotes.speaker: Sailaja Mantripragada
quotes.why: Frames governance as an enabler of AI innovation rather than a cost.

quotes.text: First, we democratized information using SharePoint, and then we democratized apps and application development using Power Platform, and now we are democratizing the intelligence by making co-pilot agents accessible to citizen developers.
quotes.speaker: Sailaja Mantripragada
quotes.why: Summarizes Microsoft's democratization arc from SharePoint to Copilot agents.

quotes.text: And agentic AI is a concept. It's a system of agents that are able to talk to each other and can retrieve context and make decisions on the fly.
quotes.speaker: Sailaja Mantripragada
quotes.why: A concise distinction between single agents and agentic AI systems.

quotes.text: Oh, MCP does play a huge role. MCP is your unifying layer because it's similar to APIs for your development world.
quotes.speaker: Sailaja Mantripragada
quotes.why: Explains the Model Context Protocol with a familiar API analogy.

quotes.text: You do not want agents to make decisions that involve security, risk, compliance, and things like that. Even if they do, we need human oversight on any autonomous agents.
quotes.speaker: Sailaja Mantripragada
quotes.why: Clear guidance on where human oversight must stay in agentic systems.

Pro developers, citizen developers and an AI CoE
Power Platform evolution, ALM and context engineering
Agentic AI, MCP and Copilot Studio
Autonomy, human oversight and rapid fire

takeaways: AI governance should enable innovation: start small with a few workflows, clean permissions and a triage process before scaling Copilot agents.
Copilot and citizen developers expose years of oversharing in SharePoint, which is why governance is no longer an afterthought.
Agentic AI built with Copilot Studio and MCP needs step-by-step governance and human oversight for decisions involving security, risk and compliance.
hook: Copilot agents built by citizen developers can open up every messy SharePoint room in your tenant. Microsoft MVP and MCT Sailaja Mantripragada explains how enterprises can govern Copilot Studio, Power Platform and agentic AI without slowing innovation, from triage forms to human oversight.
